# The story AI's monthly rules, called by the magic month (zin_world_magic_month), never per country.
zin_story_ai_month = {
	# Peace (06 spec): once the false god is dead, every AI realm still at war with his realm makes a white peace with it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_story_ai_afrit_peace }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_story_ai_afrit_peace
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
					zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
				}
				has_war = yes
			}
			every_enemy_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				white_peace = { tag = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
